Schedule pages

Viewer help

  • Default: every page opens in Fit Page mode
  • ← / →: previous or next page
  • + / −: zoom by 5%
  • 0: reset to 115%
  • F: fit page
  • W: fit width
  • M: pages menu
  • C: high contrast
  • Esc: close menu or return to dashboard

Ctrl/⌘ + mouse wheel and two-finger pinch also zoom the schedule.
